verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only usage-based pricing ("Only pay for what you use", "pay by the second with no reserved capacity"). Nothing in the pack mentions a free tier, included credits, or self-serve signup without sales. Pay-as-you-go billing is related but is not the free tier or credits the story asks for, so the axis applies and is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can start building with a free tier or included credits without talking to sales
